Job Title: AI Native Developer

Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Pune, Chennai, Jaipur, Bhopal, Hyderabad

Experience: 6+ years

Must have Valid passport




The Hiring Manager is looking for a 6 to 12 years experienced AI-Native Software Engineer with a strong software engineering background in Python, system design, distributed systems, and backend development, combined with hands-on production experience in building Agentic AI applications using LangGraph/LangChain, designing RAG pipelines, prompt/context engineering, cloud deployment, and AI-assisted software development tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code.


Responsibilities:



Have 6-12 years of Software Engineering experience.
Be a strong coder with excellent knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, System Design, Distributed Systems, APIs, and Backend Development.
Have hands-on experience building production Agentic AI applications, not just using ChatGPT or Copilot.
Have designed RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Have experience with LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen or similar Agentic AI frameworks.
Be able to write technical specifications, architect solutions, and review AI-generated code.
Have experience deploying AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understand CI/CD, Testing, Security, Code Review, and Software Architecture.
